name: extract_theorem_benchmark
description: A dataset for extracting theorem-related elements (e.g., theorem statements, lemmas, proofs) from scientific/math documents. It measures systems' ability to localize and correctly extract theorem spans and associated metadata from document text/markup. The benchmark is intended for information-extraction and span-detection models in mathematical/scientific corpora.
evaluation_method: Span-level F1 / exact_match for extracted theorem text
reputation: A niche academic dataset hosted on Hugging Face for theorem extraction research with limited but growing use in document IE studies.
